scope: N7/N8/N9 evidence audit, not automatic scientific sign-off

criteria.requirement: Fixed-bed lake at rest with slope/curvature combinations
criteria.gap: Satisfied in the named liquid fixtures: smooth, continuous one-cell and fully wet parabolic lakes in 1D/2D, all slope/curvature pairs and supported stage counts. Arbitrary boundaries and variable composition are not silently claimed.

criteria.requirement: No uphill leakage and refinement behavior
criteria.gap: Satisfied: all Gate-H refinements retain original aggregate and zero-uphill limits and pass full h/eta fields at common IMEX times and approved historical SSPRK2 limits.

criteria.requirement: Reconstruction positivity, compatible mean momentum and velocity bounds
criteria.gap: Satisfied in the defined fixtures: stationary/moving-contact admissibility plus 138 finite-time geometry cases, raw stage/face positivity and compatible normal/tangential closure pass.

criteria.requirement: Smooth, rough and seeded random continuous Q1 beds in 1D and 2D
criteria.gap: Satisfied: rough/inclined 2D fronts, oblique/axial ramps, quarter-turn covariance and circular refinement pass finite-time independent fields for N_RK=2,3,4.

criteria.requirement: Variable-composition transport and signed component conservation
criteria.gap: Satisfied in the defined 90-equilibrium/72-contact matrix per profile: independent conservative/thermal fields, analytic refinement, both signed directions/axes and every raw-stage component/carrier budget pass; original numerical limits are unchanged.

criteria.requirement: Production semidiscrete residual, CFL and time integration against clean reference
criteria.gap: Satisfied in the authorized contract: retained default fields/checkpoints and proposed/accepted times are bitwise unchanged; combined matches the clean spatial bound, x/y/point grids and all stage/policy/sentinel/event/growth tests pass with actual 1/4 teams in both profiles. Universal autonomous roundoff equality and N9 scientific approval are not claimed.

criteria.requirement: Mass conservation and symmetry
criteria.gap: Satisfied in the defined fixtures: raw/final mass budgets, quarter-turn covariance, approved evolution-induced fourth-harmonic refinement and retained absolute bound pass. General inlet budgets remain in N9.

criteria.requirement: Real one/four-thread equivalence
criteria.gap: Satisfied: all original-duration restart and full Gate-H thread pairs plus every dynamic trajectory and stage-face payload are bitwise equal across actual one/four-thread teams.

criteria.requirement: Exact deterministic and stochastic continuation
criteria.gap: Satisfied: original-duration deterministic and stochastic restart trajectories pass in both profiles and with actual one/four-thread teams. Do not replace these regressions with shortened runs.

criteria.requirement: Solid availability, substrate inventory and source-mask limits before nodal averaging
criteria.gap: Satisfied: flat single/four-vertex identity, solid/liquid and gas-carrier caps, exhausted reserves, signed gas inflow, conservative/thermal/pore-pressure transactions, cutoff and full/partial source masks pass. Exhaustive rheology/vaporization/entrainment characterization is outside this closure.

criteria.requirement: Mass-lumped global bed-volume identity including dry cells and boundaries
criteria.gap: Satisfied: production uniform-grid volume balance passes across all refinements and seeded updates, including dry contributors/boundaries. User accepts the separately verified unequal-area algebra test; nonuniform production meshes remain unsupported.

criteria.requirement: Exact B_vertex restart with bed evolution
criteria.gap: Satisfied: exact B_vertex/inventory reload, poisoned-cache refresh, nonzero resumed exchange and full evolving-bed continuation pass. Additional physical-model characterization is not a new restart prerequisite.

criteria.requirement: Authoritative nodal bed and refreshed geometry after bed modifications
criteria.gap: Satisfied: independent Q1/LS/Hessian/G checks pass after every seeded 1D/2D update, including retained-state production transactions and all intermediate actual 1/4-thread payloads. The bounded 1D accumulation correction preserves coefficients and OpenMP.

criteria.requirement: Wet/dry local geometric mismatch is diagnosed
criteria.gap: Satisfied: three smooth/wet-dry refinements in both dimensions show decreasing area-L1 mismatch and front localization without dry flow injection. Signed/L1/Linf and rough-stress volume/finite-geometry assertions pass; rough rates have no convergence requirement.

criteria.requirement: HP-PCCU is the sole production backend with canonical state/thermal conventions
criteria.gap: State-conversion, thermal/component identities, Gate-H, and the closed N7/N8 numerical contracts have direct evidence. The scientific owner approved the canonical production scope represented by this acceptance plan and the pinned ETNA/ETNA_LAVA evidence; no broader universal model claim is made.

criteria.requirement: Pinned source, tools, compiler flags, inputs, outputs and reference checksums
criteria.gap: The historical N9 artifact pins toolchain, profiles, fixtures, source/reference hashes and pre-change outputs. The v5 matrix is versioned in docs/acceptance/results_n9_restart_v5_2026_10_11.json with source, executable, input, output and runner hashes; all 32 pinned production-source hashes and the runner hash match the repository. The scientific owner approved checksum/metadata retention; preserving bulky raw run payloads is not required.

criteria.requirement: Clean strict/debug and optimized validation
criteria.gap: The existing N7/N8 acceptance artifacts record full strict/debug and optimized builds and tests. The v5 ETNA/ETNA_LAVA matrix passes all 8 build/case/thread combinations using the retained clean profile executables; the official stochastic restart regression also passes v5 in both profiles and actual 1/4-thread teams. The v5 long-run matrix reuses those builds rather than rebuilding them. M12c build automation and portability are a separate roadmap milestone; no missing rerun of the entire historical matrix is implied by this criterion.

criteria.requirement: Explicit tolerances and comparator policy
criteria.gap: The scientific owner approved the recorded comparator and budget scope: same-build restart and 1/4-thread comparisons require exact equality; existing field/identity limits remain unchanged; ETNA is evaluated over its full 0–200 s run; the ETNA_LAVA mass budget is evaluated only through the last saved output before boundary contact (3180 s). The exact first-contact time is unknown because outputs are spaced by 60 s. No new threshold is inferred from the observed residuals and no solver tolerance was changed.

criteria.requirement: Long EXAMPLE_ETNA/EXAMPLE_ETNA_LAVA acceptance and regression ownership
criteria.gap: The v5 matrix passes 8/8 full/split comparisons for full-duration ETNA (200 s) and ETNA_LAVA (3600 s), in optimized and strict/debug profiles with actual 1/4-thread teams. Native fields, canonical checkpoint records, runout/mass-centre CSV histories and ESRI outputs match the corresponding uninterrupted and pre-change baselines; all four within-profile thread pairs pass. ETNA preprocessing rasters match the retained user data. The owner-approved lava mass budget ends at 3180 s, before the first saved output with boundary flow; full-field and restart checks still extend through 3600 s. Machine-readable evidence: docs/acceptance/results_n9_restart_v5_2026_10_11.json.

criteria.requirement: Scientific baseline sign-off
criteria.gap: The scientific owner explicitly approved the canonical scope, recorded comparator and budget policy, and checksum-based evidence-retention policy for commit 3f7329c85d2e30e33cf68348721329f7726b01c1. The dated approval and its limits are recorded in docs/acceptance/results_n9_restart_v5_2026_10_11.json and docs/acceptance/N9_RESTART_V5_2026_10_11.md. This approval applies to the pinned scope and revision only.

criteria.requirement: Examples, source inputs, versioned restart and scientific output metadata match canonical semantics
criteria.gap: The v5 checkpoint restores runout origin/initial offsets, prior barycentre and steady-stop state; CSV continuation, missing/incompatible histories, v4 rejection, evolving-topography restart and official stochastic restart are directly tested. The stochastic regression passed with actual 1/4-thread teams after being corrected to disable serial mode and verify the effective team size. All 8 ETNA/ETNA_LAVA checkpoint/field/CSV/ESRI continuation comparisons pass. The existing native schema, thermal/component identities and dry-output convention are retained. The scientific owner approved the canonical output scope recorded in N9-06.
